notes: The input snapshot format is oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/Act.java:205 (keys {desc: [held, presses]}). The oraclePresses/oracleSet methods are this project's hooks, not vanilla. Verified key_state use in csrc/engine/survival.c (presses consumed for hotbar, inventory, drop, attack) and csrc/engine/session.c (session_parse_act, the snapshot parse) and csrc/play/play.c (tape_row, the tape write). Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): bindings are the pinned defaults. Formerly listed as missing: key codes themselves are not tracked natively (the native table matches vanilla bindings by description, so a rebound key in options.txt would not replay) resetKeyBindingArrayAndHash and the key-code hash have no counterpart because the native registry is static
